title: Perfect Is The Cleansing Bath
summary: Comparison is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
lifeApplication: Bring the mind back from the other person to the state of your own heart. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.

source.lifeApplication: Bring the mind back from the other person to the state of your own heart. Let the line meet the ordinary room before self-judgment starts arranging it.

evidence.turn: Keep returning to this turn: Says Nanak, my True Guru is Perfect.
